# FAS - Fine Art Supplies Ltd.

> > FAS is an educational paint and art supplies manufacturer offering tempera, acrylics, fabric inks, and specialty paints for classrooms, artists, and creative projects.

FAS (Fine Art Supplies Ltd.) is a New Zealand-based manufacturer of high-quality art supplies including paints, inks, and creative materials. Their products are designed for educational use, professional artists, and DIY enthusiasts, with a focus on safety standards (EN71-3, EN71-7, NZ/AS ISO 8124-2003) and non-toxic formulations.

## Key Topics

- FAS Super Tempera
- Fastex Fabric Painting Ink
- Tempera Paint
- Acrylic Paint
- Washable Paint
- UV Glow Fluorescent
- Poster Paint
- Safety Standards (EN71, ISO 8124)
- Non-Toxic
- School Art Supplies
- Classroom Art Supplies
- People Paint
- Indian Ink
- Block Printing Ink
- New Zealand Manufacturer

## Core Paint Products

- [FAS Super Tempera School Poster Paint](https://www.faspaints.com/super-tempera): FAS Super Tempera product page with UV glow, metallic, and skin tone options
- [FAS Total Wash School Paint will wash from all Kids Clothing](https://www.faspaints.com/total-wash-poster-paint): Total Wash washable poster paint designed to remove from children's clothing
- [FAS Fine Art Student Acrylic Paint for artists and the classroom](https://www.faspaints.com/fine-art-student-acrylic): Student acrylic paint product page with permanence and performance features
- [Kids Colour Poster Paint | FAS](https://www.faspaints.com/kids-colour-poster-paint): Kids Colour washable poster paint for early childhood and primary students
- [FAS School Powder Paint](https://www.faspaints.com/powder-paint): Powder paint product with preparation instructions, add water for classroom use

## Specialty & Decorative Paints

- [FAS People Paint in skin tone colours](https://www.faspaints.com/people-paint): People Paint in multicultural skin tones with tempera formulation
- [UV Glow Fluorescent Paints by FAS - Fine Art Supplies](https://www.faspaints.com/uv-glow-fluorescent-paints): UV glow fluorescent paints for classroom, parties, discos, and posters
- [FAS Metallic Paints made by FAS - Fine Art Supplies NZ Ltd](https://www.faspaints.com/metallic-paints): Metallic paints and inks for acrylic, tempera, and block printing applications
- [FAS Professional Face and Body Paint](https://www.faspaints.com/face-paint): Professional face and body paint with cosmetic pigments for extended wear

## Fabric & Textile Products

- [FAS | Fastex Fabric Painting Ink - create you own fashion](https://www.faspaints.com/fastex-textile-ink): Fastex fabric painting ink for creating custom clothing and textile designs
- [Fastex - Paint your own t-shirt set of 5 colours](https://www.faspaints.com/fastex-fabric-paint-set): Fastex fabric paint boxed set with five colors for DIY t-shirt creation
- [Paint your own t-shirt with Fastex Fabric Painting ink](https://www.faspaints.com/fastex-paint-a-tee-shirt): Tutorial on painting and creating custom t-shirts with Fastex textile ink
